text: Reza - band playing @ the Lexington Fri at 9. said he'd put me on the door list
Mehmet's housewarming sat from 7. new flat in Walthamstow, 2 bed. bring wine not flowers - his gf Sofia allergic to lilies
Tunde running Cardiff half sun morning. nervous re: knee, physio said ok. text him good luck sat night
Joanna + Ibrahim - 10th anniv dinner next Tues @ that Turkish place. they've invited us for after, drinks @ theirs ~9pm
Irina's recital cancelled, teacher off sick. rescheduled? ask her
Ann (Mrs Walsh next door) - grandson Liam in school nativity Thurs 2pm. she's going w/ her daughter. ask how it went
Ebony - quiz team won the league final last wk!! £200 voucher. they're doing a meal w/ it this weekend

Pooja's brother Tadhg in a play @ the Arcola, runs til the 28th. Divya going opening night Wed, I said maybe the Sat matinee at 2:30. Pooja says he's been a wreck in rehearsals, forgetting lines, director shouting. he does 2nd job in a bar too so barely sleeping. text him something encouraging before Wed + book tix for Sat
Omar - 5-a-side final tomorrow evening 8pm. he's captain now. very stressed, hasn't slept properly. msg him tmrw afternoon
Jack & Lola engagement party Sat 14th, 3pm til late, her parents' garden in Surrey. need to RSVP by Fri
Hana - violin grade 6 exam Mon at half 10. her mum says she's practising 2hrs/day. wish her luck sun
bins tues not weds this wk. also dentist Fri at 4

Oscar invited me to his 40th - surprise, organised by his wife Olga. Sat 8th, upstairs @ the Crown, 7:30 sharp. don't tell him. chip in for the group present - Olga thinking a turntable, he's into vinyl
Hugo's dog Biscuit - vet op tomorrow morning, lump on leg. he's worried. check in w/ him tmrw eve
Yusuf & Fatima hosting Eid dinner in a fortnight, sat. asked if I can bring dessert. Fatima vegetarian. their kids (twins, 6) love chocolate anything
Olivia - choir concert @ St Martin's next Sun at 6. tix £12. I'm going w/ Shanice
Seo-yeon's leaving drinks thurs 6pm onwards @ the Hope. moving to Seoul for new job. get card + sign it, office whip round w/ Alina
Julien ran Berlin marathon sun - 3:41! PB. send congrats
Pedro - wedding off. he + Rana split last month. go gently, he's not great. meet for a pint next wk
Chidi - big presentation to board Fri 11am. nervous, kept saying so. her manager Mrs Thomas will be there
Reza's sister Fatima - baby shower Sun the 22nd at 2. Reza asked if I'd help set up that morning
Mehmet supports Galatasaray, watches every match. derby tmrw night. dnt text during
Sofia doing pottery class Weds evenings now. loves it. wants her own wheel eventually - bday idea?

Tunde - his uncle's 70th in Lagos, flying out Thurs, back the Mon after. whole family going, his mum's organised it all for months, 300 guests apparently. Tunde's wife Joanna can't go - work - so she's on her own w/ the dog all wk. ask him about it when he's back + maybe check on Joanna midweek
Irina - housewarming went well sat apparently, her partner Ibrahim cooked for 30. their cat Pushkin hid under bed all night lol. she's knackered
dinner w/ Joanna tmrw 7:30 @ Dishoom. I'm booking
Ann's husband - hip op went fine, home Weds. she's exhausted though. pop round w/ soup this weekend
Ebony's son in under 11s cup final sat morning 10am. she's more nervous than he is. ask her sat pm how it went
Liam - got into the London Gay Men's Chorus!! first rehearsal next Mon. said I'd come to the winter concert, Dec 12th 7pm
Divya - Diwali party @ hers, sat 1st from 6. bring sparklers. her in-laws staying the wk before so she's frazzled
Tadhg - hurling. plays for a London club, matches most Suns. Irish dad, mum from Leeds

Omar's team lost the final 3-2 on pens. gutted, he missed the last one. his gf Shanice says he's been sulking since, won't talk about it, deleted the team group chat. he takes this stuff really personally. take him for a curry fri, don't mention football unless he does

Jack - stag do Prague, 3 nights from Thurs the 6th. I'm in. flights booked, owe Liam £180 for the apt. Liam's best man, he's planning go karting fri + a beer spa thing sat. Jack's dad coming for the sat only. Lola made Liam promise no strippers. pay Liam by end of the wk
Lola: wants a nice fountain pen, mentioned it twice. bday's the 19th. she's into calligraphy since summer

Hana's dad (Mr Tanaka) - retiring end of Nov after 30 yrs @ the council. family doing a dinner sun 30th, 1pm, Hana asked me to come. her brother Hugo flying back from Toronto for it, first time home in 2 yrs. Hana wants to give her dad a framed photo of the old office, asked me to help find one. he loves gardening, so maybe also a voucher
Oscar - brother Hugo's play opens Fri at 7.30 @ the Bridewell. Oscar said Hugo terrified, first lead role. go opening or 2nd night? txt Hugo break a leg Fri afternoon
Pooja - cancelled Sat's dinner, little one has chicken pox. rebook for next month, maybe the 15th
Olga - choir / book club / pilates. never free Weds. vegan, no nuts
Yusuf - job interview tmrw 9am, BBC data team. 2nd round. wants to leave current place badly. text him tonight + ask how it went tmrw lunch
Fatima's mum in hospital since Sun, chest infection. Yusuf says she's v anxious. send a msg to Fatima, nothing pushy
pick up suit from dry cleaners Thurs before 5. then train to Mum's Fri 6:15
Shanice + Pedro - pub quiz Tues 8pm, they asked me to join team. Pedro's flatmate Chidi joining too
Seo-yeon's sister visiting from Busan next week. Seo-yeon taking her to a Spurs match sun 4:30. first time at a footie match
Alina - won 2nd prize in the photography comp! exhibition opening Thurs the 13th at 6:30, gallery in Peckham. must go, get her flowers
Julien + his partner Hugo - 5yr anniversary this wknd, Paris trip. Julien back Mon. ask how Paris was

Rana - got a puppy! cockapoo called Doughnut. her kids obsessed. picking him up properly sat. her husband Yusuf was v against it, now apparently the one sleeping downstairs w/ him lol. puppy classes start in a fortnight, Tues evenings. Rana asked if my sister still has the crate she doesn't use
Reza @ work: promoted to head of sound. starts after Xmas. drinks thurs eve, all of us. he wants it low key
Chidi - presentation went great apparently, board approved budget. follow up - ask what's next
Mehmet + Sofia - their son's 1st bday party sun at 11, soft play place Hackney. present? Sofia says clothes 18-24m or books
Tunde's knee flared after the half. GP Weds, might need scan. he's fed up. call him thurs

Joanna mentioned her boss is leaving - she might go for the role. interview prob in Nov. she's not sure she wants it, says the hours would kill her w/ the kids still small. Ibrahim thinks she should, they argued about it at dinner apparently. her mum's on Ibrahim's side too. don't push either way
Irina's book club tonight 7pm. reading Middlemarch, I haven't started

Ann - garden open day sun 2-5. proceeds to hospice. she's been prepping for weeks. said I'd bake - lemon drizzle + something gluten free for her neighbour Irina. Ann's grandson Liam doing face painting, her daughter running the plant stall. bake sat evening, drop round sun at 1 to help set up tables

Ebony & her sister Shanice - joint 30th party Fri 21st, 8pm til 2, warehouse in Hackney Wick. fancy dress, theme 'disco'. Ebony asked me to DJ first hour. Shanice says don't get them presents, just come
Liam's flatmate Omar - comedy open mic next Tues at 8.30, first time ever. Liam says he's shaking already. go + bring Divya? remind Omar he'll be fine Tues morning
Divya - hates surprise parties. noted.
Tadhg's mum Mrs Morris - funeral Thurs 11am @ St Anne's, wake after @ the Swan. Pooja's driving us. send card to Tadhg before
car MOT Mon 8am, then work from home rest of day. gym tues/thurs mornings this wk
Pedro's band - gig Sat 25th @ the Windmill, doors 8. he's on bass, Jack on drums. Jack's wife Lola + their kids coming early set. I'm going w/ Hana, meet @ Brixton tube 7:45

Olivia - ran 10k on sun, first race after her op. slow but finished, so proud. she's thinking of a half in spring. Hugo + Olga were there cheering. sent her a pic, need to also send the vid tmrw morning
